description:
Port pi-mono's SessionManager as a pure Elixir data structure (not a GenServer —
the Session GenServer owns it as a value in its state).

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts

## Struct

defstruct [
  entries: [],     # all entries oldest-first
  by_id:   %{},    # id => entry, O(1) lookup
  leaf_id: nil,    # id of the current head (most recent entry); nil when empty
]

## Append operations

Each append: generates a new id via SessionEntry.generate_id(MapSet.new(Map.keys(sm.by_id))),
sets parent_id = sm.leaf_id, advances leaf_id, appends to entries list and by_id map.

  new/0
  new/1          — opts: [initial_entries: [SessionEntry.t()]]
                   rebuild by_id and leaf_id from the entries list
  append_message/2           — (sm, Message.t()) -> sm; appends MessageEntry
  append_compaction/4        — (sm, summary, first_kept_entry_id, tokens_before) -> sm
                               also accepts opts keyword: [details: term, from_hook: boolean]
  append_custom_entry/3      — (sm, custom_type, data \\ nil) -> sm
  append_custom_message_entry/4 — (sm, custom_type, content, opts \\ []) -> sm
                                  opts: [display: boolean, details: term]
  append_label/3             — (sm, entry_id, label) -> sm; label can be nil to remove

## Tree traversal

get_branch/1  — returns linear path from root to current leaf, oldest-first
get_branch/2  — (sm, from_id) path from root to the given entry id
Algorithm: start at leaf_id, follow parent_id links via by_id until nil, reverse.
Reference: pi-mono lines 1034-1043.

get_latest_compaction_entry/1 — walks entries in reverse, returns first
%SessionEntry.CompactionEntry{} or nil.
Reference: pi-mono lines 301-308.

## build_session_context/1 — THE critical function

Returns %{messages: [OctoPi.Agent.Message.t()], model: term(), thinking_level: atom()}.
This is what the Loop passes to the transport for every LLM call.

Algorithm (port from pi-mono buildSessionContext lines 315-422):
  1. Call get_branch/1 to get the linear path, oldest-first.
  2. Find the latest CompactionEntry in the path.
  3a. If a CompactionEntry exists:
      - Emit one synthetic %OctoPi.AI.Message.User{content: entry.summary, timestamp: ...}
        as the FIRST message.
      - Walk entries from first_kept_entry_id onward (skip any entry whose id appears
        before first_kept_entry_id in the path).
      - For each MessageEntry in that range: include entry.message.
      - For each CustomMessageEntry in that range: synthesize a User message from
        entry.content.
      - Skip: CustomEntry, CompactionEntry, LabelEntry, ModelChangeEntry,
              SessionInfoEntry, BranchSummaryEntry.
  3b. If no CompactionEntry: include all MessageEntry.message values and
      CustomMessageEntry values from the full branch path.
  4. For model and thinking_level: walk path in reverse; find the latest
     ModelChangeEntry and use its provider/model_id. Return nil if none found.

## File

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session_manager.ex.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/session_manager_test.exs.
Port relevant tests from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/ (search for
buildSessionContext and appendCompaction in test files).
Cover:
  - append_message / get_branch / leaf_id progression
  - get_latest_compaction_entry with and without compaction entries
  - build_session_context with no compaction (all messages included)
  - build_session_context with one compaction entry (synthetic summary first,
    only kept messages after)
  - build_session_context with CustomMessageEntry included, CustomEntry excluded
title: Implement SessionManager
